namedCorpusClasses.inputVerbatim: An analyze request that names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1, or supplies a user/third-party pack.
namedCorpusClasses.passVerbatim: Request refused at admission. No evaluation.
namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned well-formed analyze-request bytes for each NT-1 limb, paired with pinned admission-refusal bytes showing no evaluation. Limb one names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1 (wrong name, wrong version, or a non-bundled identity). Limb two supplies a user pack or a third-party pack. Each record retains the presented identity or supplied-pack provenance, the refusal, and a record that no core evaluation, no policyOutcome, no facts/Coverage consumption, and no semantic-universe construction occurred. Hostile-but-well-formed means the request is constructible as an analyze request; crash/malformed/truncated remains G21. This class does not score G29 publisher-form refusal, G30 useful-install advertisement, or G23 FactCandidate/Coverage admission. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: NT-1 passVerbatim holds for both limbs. Silent admission fails. Evaluation does not run. Waiver of silent admission is forbidden. G23, G29, and G30 are not scored.

namedCorpusClasses.inputVerbatim: A pack or contribution that is not declarative-only.
namedCorpusClasses.passVerbatim: Refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded.
namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned well-formed pack or contribution bytes that are not declarative-only, paired with pinned admission-refusal bytes showing ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents remain excluded. Each record retains the non-declarative input, the refusal, and a record that no evaluation ran. This class is pack IR at analyze admission. It does not score G29 EE-5a contribution-hook/root/probe refusal, G29 EE-5b represented post-admission pre-stage substitution, or G23 provider FactCandidate/Coverage. This specification does not invent pack IR and does not discharge ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: NT-2 passVerbatim holds. A non-declarative pack or contribution is refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded. Silent admission fails. G23 and G29 are not scored.

retainedEvidence.measures: A well-formed analyze request that names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1 is refused at admission. No evaluation. Before evaluation means the core does not evaluate policyOutcome, does not consume facts or Coverage, and does not construct a semantic universe.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned analyze-request bytes that name a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1 (wrong name, wrong version, or a non-bundled identity), paired with pinned admission-refusal bytes showing no evaluation. The fixture pins the request identity, the refusal, and a record that no core evaluation, no policyOutcome, no facts/Coverage consumption, and no semantic-universe construction occurred. A first-party publisher presenting a different pack name is refused here. This member does not score G29 EE-1 publisher-form refusal, G30 useful-install advertisement of the future DR-131 pack, or G23 FactCandidate/Coverage admission. This specification does not invent a section 7.1 PlanId producing rule; admission refusal happens before identity derivation. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: A named pack identity other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1 is refused at admission. Evaluation does not run. Silent admission fails. Waiver of silent admission is forbidden. G23, G29, and G30 are not scored. A PlanId recipe is not invented.

retainedEvidence.measures: A pack or contribution that is not declarative-only is refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned pack or contribution bytes that are not declarative-only, paired with pinned admission-refusal bytes showing ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents remain excluded. The fixture pins the non-declarative input, the refusal, and a record that no evaluation ran. This member is pack IR at analyze admission. It does not score G29 EE-5a contribution-owned project hook/root/probe refusal or G29 EE-5b represented post-admission pre-stage imperative substitution. It does not score G23 provider FactCandidate/Coverage. This specification does not invent pack IR, an evaluation algorithm, or a discharge of ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: A non-declarative pack or contribution is refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded. Silent admission fails. G23 and G29 are not scored.

retainedEvidence.measures: A well-formed analyze request that supplies a user pack or a third-party pack is refused at admission. No evaluation. No user or third-party pack is admitted.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned analyze-request bytes that supply a user pack or a third-party pack, paired with pinned admission-refusal bytes showing no evaluation. The fixture pins the supplied-pack provenance (user or third-party), the refusal, and a record that no evaluation ran. Distinct from EV-1: EV-1 is the named identity (name/version other than the bundled pack); EV-3 is a supplied user or third-party pack object. Distinct from G29 EE-1: EE-1 is a component publisher neither first-party nor explicitly trusted. Distinct from G30: G30 is useful-install advertisement of the future DR-131 pack, not analyze-request admission of a supplied pack. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: A supplied user or third-party pack is refused at admission. Evaluation does not run. Silent admission fails. No user or third-party pack is admitted. G29 and G30 are not scored.
